capabilities: Open .numbers files in a dedicated read-only view
Toggle between the embedded preview thumbnail and a full tables view
Render cell formats, colours and merged cells via a built-in IWA parser
Copy tables to the clipboard as Markdown or CSV
Fall back through parsing engines to a readable preview or error message
disambiguation: Not a spreadsheet editor; it only renders .numbers files read-only and never writes to, moves or modifies them.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents extensive measured limits: the IWA parser reads 7 of 9 reference files, pre-BNC files and package-format saves are not supported, number separators are hard-coded to Spanish convention, formulas and footer rows are not shown yet, and a Numbers update can break parsing of the undocumented format.
intentEvidence: It is not a spreadsheet editor — Sheet Plus and Univer already cover that.
motivation: The author built it to fill the gap of reading Apple's proprietary .numbers format, which no other plugin interprets.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Apple's proprietary .numbers format, and existing spreadsheet plugins only edit other formats, not read this one.

relations.evidence: a port of the read path of numbers-parser
SheetJS, as a safety net: it delivers values but no formats and no styles

summary: Read-only viewer that opens Apple .numbers spreadsheets in Obsidian, rendering formatted tables with copy-to-Markdown and CSV buttons.
